data.name: Ibtihaal
data.gender_notes: Ibtihaal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: To Seek, To Strive, To Achieve
data.long_meaning: The one who seeks knowledge or strives for the pleasure of Allah. The name Ibtihaal carries the meaning “To Seek, To Strive, To Achieve” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibtihaal usually hope their child will grow to embody to seek, to strive, to achieve and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is deeply spiritual and seeks knowledge and growth through her faith
data.etymology: Ibtihaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To Seek, To Strive, To Achieve.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibtihaal total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ابتهال
in_arabic.meaning: الابتهال هو الدعاء والطلب من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ابتهال مشتق من الفعل 'ابتهل' الذي يعني الدعاء والطلب من الله تعالى بخشونة وضراعة. يعتبر الابتهال من الأسماء التي تعبر عن التواضع والخشوع أمام الله، وهو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ابتهال
in_urdu.meaning: ابتهال کا مطلب ہے دعا اور التجا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابتهال نام کا مطلب ہے دعا اور التجا کرنا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'ابتهل' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خشوع و خضوع کے ساتھ دعا کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں، کیونکہ یہ دعا اور عبادت کی تصویر کشی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इब्तिहाल
in_hindi.meaning: इब्तिहाल का अर्थ है प्रार्थना और याचना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्तिहाल नाम का अर्थ है प्रार्थना और याचना करना। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'इब्तहल' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है नम्रता और श्रद्धा के साथ प्रार्थना करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह प्रार्थना और भक्ति की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ابتهال
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ابتهال نوم مانا د دعا او بښنده غوښتنه ده. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ابتهل' فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د بښنده او تواضع سره دعا کولو معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سم دی، ځکه چې دا د دعا او عبادت د اهميت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Ibtihaal
in_english.meaning: Ibtihaal means supplication and humble request
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ibtihaal originates from the Arabic root 'b-t-h-l', which signifies supplication, humble request, and devotion. In Islamic tradition, Ibtihaal reflects a sense of humility and spiritual longing. It is derived from the Quranic concept of calling upon Allah with sincerity and urgency. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify a deep connection with faith and the act of prayer.

This is reflected in the historical role of great Islamic scholars who contributed significantly to various fields, including mathematics, astronomy, medicine, and philosophy. The name Ibtihaal, therefore, embodies the cultural importance of intellectual curiosity and scholarly pursuit.

The name "Ibtihaal" serves as a constant reminder of the importance of unwavering commitment to the spiritual journey, fostering a life-long thirst for knowledge, wisdom, and the remembrance of Allah.
